node.title: W3 paid/residual first-match partition adapter
node.statement: For any received word and any ordered paid predicates, the first-match guards plus the residual complement form an exhaustive disjoint partition of its list words. Sound paid upper allocations u_i and residual-cell allocations b_c therefore give |X(U)| <= sum_i u_i + sum_c b_c; with B_chal=B*-sum_i u_i, the W3 residual inequality implies |X(U)|<=B*. This closes only abstract ownership and additive composition, not the paid formulas or residual envelope.
